title: Status hub views (views.yml)
description: The status hub shell: a main page and a left menu of views (ADR-0013). A view is a built-in panel (exceptions-first summary, per-module grid, source table) over a selection of the registered status sources, or an external link entry naming a registry service. Nothing here acts: the hub is read-only. 1.1 adds the live agent-activity pages as panels (agents, activity, agent-analytics; agent-detail and agent-access-log, which must sit in the private group and render only for an authorized request) and the optional menu group. Evolve additively.

main.description: The view shown as the main page; must be a panel view.

act_via.description: Optional: where anything that changes something is done (the broker or approval path). The hub only links to it.

service.description: A registry service name; the link is built from the registry (public hostname, else the capability alias).

optional.description: When the service is not registered the entry is shown as unavailable instead of failing validation (agents and their dashboards are optional).

panel.description: exceptions, grid and sources are sections of the page; the agent panels (1.1) are pages of their own, served live by hnx status serve.

group.description: 1.1: a menu group; the private group renders only for a request through the trusted front door.
